canonicalization.algorithm: sha256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes
rules: Validate against the exact supported schema before digesting.
Serialize JSON objects with keys sorted lexicographically at every depth.
Use UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false, and separators ',' and ':' with no insignificant whitespace.
Preserve array order; a model must normalize semantic sets before canonical serialization.
Permit only finite JSON values; NaN and Infinity are invalid even though the current generic helper does not enforce this by itself.
Include schema name and every canonical semantic field in the digest input.
Exclude only the record's computed self-digest field; referenced digests remain included.
Render the digest as sha256 followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

compatibility_rules.decision: Schema name contains the major version; an unknown major fails closed.
New v1 records reject unknown fields except inside an explicitly typed extensions object.
Stable refs identify lineage; digests identify exact immutable revisions. Runtime selection pins digests.
Portable contract versions use SemVer, but compatibility is never inferred from a mutable alias or package version alone.
Admission is exact-digest by default; compatible ranges or explicit compatibility edges are evaluated only by the resolver.
BindingDefinition contains a logical entry point. BindingDelivery maps it to a physical package member.
BindingInstance and StateSpace stable refs have append-only immutable revisions; health/readiness are observations.
WorkspaceLock remains the sole active-workspace authority.

known_gaps: Flowboard local CRUD state has no independent state_space_ref, revision chain, authority epoch, or writer fencing token.
Flowboard production state is an atomic JSON registry, not the SQLite ResourceStorage used by prototype resources.
Local CRUD owner, resource namespace, and authority binding are all derived from the skill name.
The selected fixture has no skill.yaml:data_lifecycle declaration or executable schema migration path.
The existing artifact activation plan is package-oriented and has no semantic resolution or state-space attachment authority.
Existing evidence and attestations do not uniformly model environment, external dependency observations, or freshness.
No current record is silently reclassified as CapabilityContract, StateContract, BindingDefinition, StateSpace, ApplicationResolution, or ResolutionPlan.
